title: Mark the allowance, not just the face
hook: Which blank includes the two shown fold allowances?

knows: Everyday objects have sizes, positions and amounts
doesNotKnow: that every fold uses material, so the blank must be the finished width plus one allowance for each folded edge

misconception: Cut the blank to the finished size; the folds come out of the edges.
objective: The finished face is narrower than the blank when two side folds consume material. Adding one allowance at each edge gives the required blank width in this ideal paper model.
